title: Garlic Chilli Prawn Linguine
desc: Prawns, garlic, chilli, cherry tomatoes and lemon through linguine. Light on the oil, big on flavour.

portions.J: 200 g raw prawns, 100 g dry pasta (about 2 cups cooked)
portions.P: 130 g raw prawns, 65 g dry pasta (about 1.3 cups cooked)

ingredients.name: parsley, chopped
ingredients.food: fresh herbs (dill, mint, parsley or chives)

steps.title: Pasta on
steps.text: Cook the linguine in well-salted water. Save a mug of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Garlic and chilli
steps.text: Meanwhile, warm the oil in a big pan on medium. Add the garlic and chilli and cook gently until the garlic is just golden.

steps.title: Tomatoes
steps.text: Turn up the heat, add the tomatoes and cook until they start to burst.

steps.title: Prawns
steps.text: Add the prawns and cook until pink and curled, about 2 minutes. Don't overcook them.

steps.title: Toss it all
steps.text: Add the drained pasta, spinach, lemon zest and juice and a good splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy and the spinach wilts. Top with parmesan and parsley.

notes: The pasta water does the job extra oil would do. Use it.
